description: This file contains unit tests for runtime versioning strategies in an Orleans-based distributed system, focusing on compatibility and selector strategy modifications.

classes.name: RuntimeStrategyChangeTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying runtime changes to versioning strategies in Orleans, including compatibility and selector strategy modifications.

methods.name: ChangeCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Tests changing the compatibility strategy at runtime and its effects on grain versions.

methods.name: ChangeVersionSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Tests changing the version selector strategy at runtime and its impact on grain activation.

methods.name: ChangeDefaultVersionCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Tests changing the default compatibility strategy and its effect on existing and new grains.

methods.name: ChangeDefaultVersionSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Tests changing the default version selector strategy and its effect on grain activation.
